$comment: App and service repos that must exist. Declaring one here IS creating it: on merge, .github/workflows/app-repos.yml runs scripts/repos/create-app-repos.mjs, which creates every missing bitbaum/<name> with the given visibility and description, seeds main with templates/app-repo (the fleet auto-merge caller, without which no PR merges), then enables squash merge, auto-merge and head-branch cleanup. Everything else arrives by pull request, and the first one must add ci.yml (workflow `name: CI`). A repo that depends on a shared package also needs browser-smoke.yml, a real browser check of the built app: the merge sweep's rollout gate (docs/package-rollouts.md) holds such a PR, green CI and all, until both workflows pass on its head. Neither is seeded as a stub, since a check that tests nothing would make green mean nothing. Existing repos are never touched. Package repos are declared in package-repos.json instead.

repos.name: signin
repos.description: The shared bitbaum sign-in: one OIDC service for Google, GitHub, X, Meta and Apple, issuing a per-app subject
